task: Aegis Pilot decision-authority record: who held authority and what followed; restored error-path cleanup in the acceptance run

checks.name: pilot suite passes
checks.run: npx vitest run src/__tests__/aegis-pilot.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -5; exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}

checks.name: isolated rehearsal record carries the authority chain with a proven stop
checks.run: command -v unshare >/dev/null || { echo 'SKIP: unshare missing'; exit 0; }; d=$(mktemp -d); bash scripts/aegis-pilot-isolated-rehearsal.sh "$d/state" >/dev/null 2>&1; r=$(ls -t "$d"/state/acceptance/*.json | head -1); node -e "const a=require(process.argv[1]).record.authority; const s=a.find(x=>x.stop); process.exit(a.length===2 && s && s.afterStop.agentWorkEvents===0 && s.afterStop.terminated && a[0].granted.scopeDigest ? 0 : 1)" "$r"
